info.title: Fandom API
info.description: Campaigns, targeting, audiences, data stores, brands and Audience Exploration. The same operations are available as MCP tools at /mcp.

post.description:
Creates the campaign exactly as the app's New campaign form does. Audiences you pass are attached and start generating targeting right away. Nothing is sent to Google Ads.

Scope: `campaigns:write`.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string. Repeating a request with the same key returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

objective.description: What the campaign should achieve and for whom. Drives targeting.

brandId.description: Fills the brand's name, website and description into the campaign.

googleAdsCustomerId.description: A connected Google Ads account to create it in later. See List Google Ads accounts.

locations.description: Country or region codes, e.g. `["US"]`. Default `["US"]`.

example.name: Spring launch
example.objective: Reach parents who buy building toys for kids 6–12

get.description:
Find a starting point for a map: channels by name, channels whose audiences talk about your words, topics, and saved audiences.

Scope: `exploration:read`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A channel name, @handle, YouTube URL or a few words about an audience.

similar.description: Channels whose audiences talk about this, by meaning.

post.description:
The channels an audience also watches, grouped by shared commenters, with people counts. Built from real YouTube comment data; takes a few seconds the first time.

Scope: `exploration:read`.

query.description: Describe the audience in plain words.

sources.description: What to map. Combine up to 8.

size.description: Most channels on the map. Default 110.

notes.description: Coverage caveats worth showing to people.

audience.description: People counts. Null when they could not be measured in time.

kind.description: `core` is the audience you asked about; `adjacent` groups share its commenters.

reach.description: Share of the core audience found here, 0–1.

concentration.description: Share of these people who are in the core audience, 0–1.

fanDensity.description: How over-represented the core audience is here (1.3 = 30% more than elsewhere on the map). Null for the core itself.

seed.description: One of the channels the map was built from.

reach.description: Share of the core audience found here, 0–1.

concentration.description: Share of these people who are in the core audience, 0–1.

fanDensity.description: How over-represented the core audience is here (1.3 = 30% more than elsewhere on the map). Null for the core itself.

get.description:
What a channel makes, its topics and its latest videos.

Scope: `exploration:read`.

bearerAuth.description: An API key from Settings → API access, starting with `fnd_`.

requestId.description: Quote this when asking for help.

BadRequest.description: The request is missing something or has a bad value. The message says what.

Unauthorized.description: No API key, or the key is wrong or revoked.

PaymentRequired.description: The workspace's plan doesn't include this.

Forbidden.description: The key doesn't have the scope, or isn't allowed this campaign or account.

NotFound.description: Nothing with that id in this workspace.

Conflict.description: The current state doesn't allow this (for example, it's already done or still generating).

RateLimited.description: More than 120 requests in a minute. Wait and retry.

UpstreamError.description: Google Ads didn't answer as expected. The message says whether anything changed.
